create_granite_speech_processor: create a GraniteSpeechProcessor instance with an audio processor and tokenizer for multimodal audio-text inference
run_granite_speech_call: run the GraniteSpeechProcessor __call__ method with text input and torch audio tensor to produce a BatchFeature with tokenized text and audio inputs
build_granite_speech_audio_tokens: build expanded audio placeholder tokens in text prompts by replacing audio_token with repeated placeholders matching audio feature embed sizes
test_granite_speech_validate_text: test the _get_validated_text helper to normalize string or list-of-strings text input into a list of strings
summarize_granite_speech_processor: summarize the GraniteSpeechProcessor class that combines audio processing and text tokenization for multimodal Granite Speech models
